subject: Shelf offer: compliance add-ons (audit logs, KMS/HSM, residency) — tiered credit structure
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@orthowise.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compliance packaging question for Redwood — audit logs & HSM credits

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team liked the latency profiles and the rollout controls. Procurement asked me to clarify how Redwood is structuring credits/discounts for the compliance add-ons in an early-stage commercial engagement. Specifically: 

- OrthoWise will need audit log ingestion (30 TB / month expected for Year 1), KMS + two HSM seats for key custody, and EU residency for a single region.
- Our primary ask: how are you applying credits against (a) implementation/onboarding fees, (b) recurring monthly residency/HSM charges, and (c) per-GB audit log ingestion charges?

We saw a few different patterns in your materials (amortized credits vs. up-front waivers vs. per-month offsets). For our budgeting we need a single example amortization schedule and a proposal that shows the math over 12 months. Can you also call out any minimum seat commitments for HSM that affect crediting?

If it helps, I can share our procurement template and SOW expectations (I attached the RFP attachments).

Thanks — Ellen
Ellen Park
Procurement Director, OrthoWise
ellen.park@orthowise.com
Attachment: OrthoWise_RFP_attachments.zip (zip, 1.2MB)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@orthowise.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance packaging question for Redwood — audit logs & HSM credits

Ellen —

Appreciate the detailed ask and the RFP. Attached is a concise term sheet and a 12-month amortization example (Compliance_Term_Sheet_v1.pdf). High-level summary below, and I included the formulas we used so you can plug your actual ingest numbers.

Summary (example applied to the OrthoWise baseline you shared):
- One-time onboarding/implementation fee (standard): $80k. We propose a 50% one-time credit that is applied as an invoice credit at contract signing ($40k credit).
- Residency setup (EU region): $20k one-time + $3k/mo recurring. We propose accelerating a $12k shelf credit to offset first 4 months of recurring residency charges (applied as monthly invoice offset)
- HSM: standard billing is $7k per HSM seat/month. For pilot/commit, we can offer a blended rate where the first 2 seats receive a $3k/month credit each for the first 6 months (effectively reducing seat cost), and any additional seats are standard price.
- Audit logs: per-GB ingest charged at $0.015/GB. For bulk commits we offer tiered ingest rebates; in your case (30TB/mo) the first 6 months get a 20% per-GB rebate applied as a monthly credit (we modeled as a negative line on the monthly invoice).

Why this structure? It balances Redwood's need to cover setup costs with OrthoWise's need for near-term OPEX predictability. It also keeps credits tied to the billing buckets you care about (onboarding, monthly residency/HSM, and per-GB ingest).

Attached: Compliance_Term_Sheet_v1.pdf (term sheet + amortization table).

Quick asks: can you confirm the preferred timing for credits (apply at invoice generation vs. apply as one line credit at month end)? Also, does your procurement require credits to be listed as a line-item discount or as a separately tracked credit (we can do either — just affects how finance maps it).

– Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: Compliance_Term_Sheet_v1.pdf (PDF, 42KB)

Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: OrthoWise credit math and approval path

Folks —

Quick internal note after reviewing Mateo's draft term sheet: a couple of things to lock before we give OrthoWise the final: 

1) Implementation credit: 50% one-time is OK for a pilot but finance wants a contingent clause — credit applies only if contract executed within 45 days and a minimum 6-month committed spend of $25k/mo. We should confirm with the customer whether that commitment is acceptable.

2) HSM seat credits: inbound ask for 2 seats with 6-month partial credits. If they convert to >3 seats within 9 months we should auto-convert remaining credits into a per-seat rebate (to avoid open-ended offsets). Proposed language: "credits apply to first two seats for the first 6 months; if additional seats are added, remaining credit budget will be reallocated as a per-seat rebate pro rata."

3) Audit log rebate modeling: for 30TB/mo we modeled a 20% rebate for months 1–6; finance flagged risk if actual ingest < 18TB/mo. Recommend adding a floor (applies if avg ingest across months 1–3 >= 18TB/mo).

Tessa/Hannah — can you surface any procurement/legal constraints about how we must show the credits on the SOW? Hannah — PM for Credits program wants to know if this is a special one-off or if we should onboard them into the shelf offer catalogue (preferred).

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Shelf offer: compliance add-ons (audit logs, KMS/HSM, residency) — tiered credit structure

Mateo —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the amortization table, that helps a lot. Two quick clarifications before we route through legal: 

1) Credit visibility: Procurement prefers credits shown as discrete line-item offsets on the first 6 invoices rather than a lump one-time credit, so we can map to our internal chargeback. If you can do that, please indicate in the SOW language.

2) HSM seat concession: we can accept the 50% onboarding credit conditional on the 6-month $25k/mo minimum, but we need the HSM seat credits to apply even if we temporarily scale below 3 seats during month 2 (our pilot churn occasionally). Can we put a 9-month lookback window for seat-month averaging to avoid losing credits for short dips?

If you can update the term sheet with those two bullets we can get legal looped and aim to route a PO the week of Jun 28. Happy to hop on a 30-min call if helpful.

Best,
Ellen
Ellen Park
Procurement Director, OrthoWise
ellen.park@orthowise.com
